synopsis: A few months after the Blood Knights destroy the Amani-driven Scourge incursion inside southern Eversong, the order proves its worth through repeated defense of the runestone boundary, dangerous Ghostlands deployments, and limited coordination with Forsaken scouts; Tranquillien and the Ghostlands remain hostile and unheld. Regular communication with Kael’thas’s forces in Outland keeps the prince’s promised future alive in Silvermoon. Lord Sanguinar leads a small Outland delegation to receive Blood Knight power for Kael’thas’s army. Liadrin remembers Sanguinar’s brutality from the Outland campaign. During binding, she stops him when he tries to seize control of Astalor’s calibration. In a later spar, Sanguinar legitimately uses substantial Light to turn the exchange, then violates the declared target restriction, ignores Daric’s yield, continues after Daric falls, and breaks his shoulder without remorse. His failure is cruelty and disobedience rather than the amount of power needed to win. Liadrin sends Sanguinar back with only three successfully bound soldiers. While Silvermoon’s Blood Knights prepare for another southern patrol, the Dark Portal snaps shut and severs contact with Outland without warning.
title: Chapter 13: Silence Beyond the Portal
